summary: Neff Gaming completes a massive 2,750 Heliolite Dice summoning session on the Reversal Summon banner to max out Child of Chaos to Inspiration 5 and unlock his exclusive Mythic artifact, Dragonbone Catalyst. While successful, Neff issues a strong warning to players against chasing max Inspiration with real money due to the high financial cost and potential post-spending regret. He equips the maxed Child of Chaos with the upgraded Dragonbone Catalyst to test in Temporal Vortex against top-tier Anselmo teams. The video demonstrates the heavy dice commitment required for high Inspiration levels on Legendary heroes.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.verdict: High-tier support unit requiring heavy investment
heroes.note: Extremely potent buff and debuff support whose team-wide damage boost scales heavily with his Exclusive Mythic Artifact (Dragonbone Catalyst) and higher Inspiration levels.

teams.note: Integrated at Inspiration 5 with Dragonbone Catalyst to rival Anselmo teams and push boss scores past 60 Billion damage.

meta_changes: Child of Chaos with Dragonbone Catalyst provides major elemental damage buffing and damage reduction across multi-element teams.
tips: Do not spend extreme amounts of money to force Inspiration 5 on a single Legendary hero unless prepared for high opportunity costs.
Prioritize obtaining a hero's Exclusive Mythic Artifact from the Artifact Shop using duplicate Soul Imprints before spending extras elsewhere.
title: I Spent 2,750 Dice on Inspiration 5... Don't Do This! | Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
